capabilities: Encrypt notes, attachments and file paths on device before upload
Sync across devices via cloud with LAN acceleration and cloud fallback
Sync selected settings, plugins, themes and snippets
Recover note version history and deleted notes within retention limits
Password-protect whole notes or selected text and recover encrypted drafts
extras: Hosted service, not self-hosted: the server runs on Oracle Cloud in the US with encrypted objects in Cloudflare R2. Free plan is 50 MB, one cloud vault, unlimited devices; paid plans from $1/month via Stripe (some accounts Dodo Payments). Requires Obsidian 1.12.7+; current stable 1.1.10. Account identity, vault/device labels and usage metadata are outside content encryption, and the README states encryption and history do not replace independent backups. Full walkthrough lives in USER-GUIDE.md; support by email and X.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync is a paid service, and users who want encrypted multi-device sync with LAN acceleration need an alternative that keeps file contents unreadable to the server.

requires.name: Smart Sync account (Google, GitHub or email)
Paid plan above the 50 MB free tier
